newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Cilcorp rating raised.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Cilcorp rating raised.

text.p: -- EVEREN Securities Inc Monday changed its rating on Cilcorp Inc to outperform from market performer for the intermediate and long terms, citing relative price performance.

-- EVEREN said the stock price underperformed since early October and now offers a yield that is 80 basis points above average. EVEREN expects an improvement in earnings per share, which it said was no longer reflected in the stock price, to materialize in 1997.

-- EVEREN also lowered its fiscal 1996 earnings estimate to $2.90 per share from $3.40 to reflect results from the first nine months of the year. The 1997 estimate was also "refined" to $3.40 from $3.45, EVEREN said.
-- Clicorp is the parent of Central Illinois Light Co.
-- Its stock was up 3/4 Monday at 37.
